title: Writing / Style / Apostrophes
slide_intent: Apply possessive endings consistently so a reader encounters familiar grammar even after unusual final letters.
strategic_value: A three-case comparison can help Duolingo avoid inconsistent treatment of names and nouns across copy.
demonstration: Examples ending in s, x and z compare apostrophe-plus-s forms with apostrophe-only alternatives.
practical_value: Add the possessive ending according to the singular-noun rule rather than dropping the extra s.
